examples.text: kiṃ ummatto'si, nanu idān'eva divākaro atthaṅ'gato, so kathaṃ imaṃ puṇṇacandaṃ anubandhamāno uggacchissati?

46606.meaning1: gift; present (made to someone who brings good news)

examples.text: etañ'c'āhaṃ assarathaṃ, sahassañ'c'āpi sārathi, tevijjaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sutvā, puṇṇapattaṃ dadāmi te.
tena kho pana samayena bhagavā tadah'uposathe pannarase puṇṇāya puṇṇamāya rattiyā bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto abbhokāse nisinno hoti.
das'āh'ānāgataṃ kattikatemāsikapuṇṇamaṃ bhikkhuno pan'eva accekacīvaraṃ uppajjeyya, accekaṃ maññamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbaṃ

46610.commentary: (THa) tassa jātadivase tasmiṃ gehe sabbā rittakumbhiyo suvaṇṇamāsānaṃ puṇṇā ahesuṃ. ten'assa puṇṇamāso'ti nāmaṃ akaṃsu.
46610.notes: Theragāthā verse 10 (TH1.10, TH10) is attributed to him.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā puṇṇamāso thero gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.
susaṃvut'atto visikh'antare caraṃ, kulesu kāmesu asaṅgamānaso, cando yathā dosinapuṇṇamāsiyā, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.

46618.meaning1: name of a water-carrying servant girl; lay name of Puṇṇā therī

examples.text: jānantī vata maṃ bhoti, puṇṇike paripucchasi, karontaṃ kusalaṃ kammaṃ, rundhantaṃ katapāpakaṃ.
ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā puṇṇiyo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo yena app'ekadā tathāgataṃ dhammadesanā paṭibhāti app'ekadā nappaṭibhātī'ti?

46623.meaning1: sowing bag (with an opening at each end)

examples.text: seyyathā'pi bhikkhave ubhatomukhā putoḷi pūrā nānāvihitassa dhaññassa seyyath'idaṃ sālīnaṃ vīhīnaṃ muggānaṃ māsānaṃ tilānaṃ taṇḍulānaṃ
mātā yathā niyaṃ puttaṃ, āyusā ekaputtam'anurakkhe, evam'pi sabbabhūtesu, mānasaṃ bhāvaye aparimāṇaṃ.
na tassa puttā pasavo, khettaṃ vatthuñ'ca vijjati, attā vā'pi nirattā vā, na tasmiṃ upalabbhati.

46625.meaning1: (used to form diminutives) young man; descendent; son of

examples.text: assosi kho āyasmā sāriputto sunakkhattassa licchaviputtassa vesāliyaṃ parisati evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsamānassa, n'atthi samaṇassa gotamassa uttarimanussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-viseso.
atha kho rohitasso devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
yena yena subhikkhāni, sivāni abhayāni ca, tena puttaka gacchassu, mā sokāpahato bhavā'ti.

46629.meaning1: doing one's duty towards one's children; performing one's parental task
46629.commentary: (ANa) na mātā puttakāraṇā'ti yadi mātā ete saṅgahe puttassa na kareyya, puttakāraṇā mānaṃ vā pūjaṃ vā na labheyya.

examples.text: ete ca saṅgahā n'āssu, na mātā puttakāraṇā, labhetha mānaṃ pūjaṃ vā, pitā vā puttakāraṇā.

46630.meaning1: state of being a son; fact of being a son (of)

examples.text: ahañ'hi nāma itthikā samānā buddhe pasannā dhamme pasannā saṅghe pasannā sīlesu paripūrakārinī itthittaṃ virājetvā purisattaṃ bhāvetvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā, devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyataṃ sakkassa devānam'indassa puttattaṃ ajjhupagatā.
mātāpitu upaṭṭhānaṃ, puttadārassa saṅgaho, anākulā ca kamm'antā, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.
atīte bārāṇasiyaṃ brahmadatte rajjaṃ kārente bodhisatto kāsigāmake kumbhakārakule nibbattitvā kumbhakārakammaṃ katvā puttadāraṃ posesi.

46632.meaning1: sons, wives, servants, labourers and employees
46632.constructionSummary: putta + dāra + dāsa + kammakara + porisa + ā
46632.construction:
putta + dāra + dāsa + kammakara + porisa + ā
puttadāradāsakammakaraporisa + ā
46632.compound: dvanda (putta ca dāra ca dāsa ca kammakara ca porisā ca)

examples.text: mātāpitaro sukheti pīṇeti sammā sukhaṃ pariharati. putta-dāra-dāsa-kammakara-porise sukheti pīṇeti sammā sukhaṃ pariharati. mitt'āmacce sukheti pīṇeti sammā sukhaṃ pariharati.

46633.meaning1: cared for by one's sons, wives, servants, worker, and employees
46633.constructionSummary: putta + dāra + dāsa + kammakara + porisa + anukampita
46633.construction: putta + dāra + dāsa + kammakara + porisa + anukampita
46633.sanskrit: putra + dāra + dāsa + karmakara + puruṣya + anukampita

examples.text: tam'enaṃ putta-dāra-dāsa-kammakara-porisā sakkatā garukatā mānitā pūjitā kalyāṇena manasā anukampanti, ciraṃ jīva, dīgham'āyuṃ pālehī'ti. putta-dāra-dāsa-kammakara-poris'ānukampitassa, mahānāma, kulaputtassa vuddhi'y'eva pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.

46634.meaning1: good to one's children and wife; caring for wife and kids

examples.text: mātāpitukiccakaro, puttadārahito sadā, antojanassa atthāya, ye c'assa anujīvino.

46635.commentary: (MNa) puttapaputtakā'ti puttā ca puttaputtā cā'ti evaṃ pavattā tassa param'parā.

examples.text: rañño kho pan'ānanda, maghadevassa puttapaputtakā tassa param'parā caturāsītirājasahassāni imasmiṃ'y'eva maghadevaambavane kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajiṃsu.

46636.meaning1: children and livestock; sons and cattle

examples.text: taṃ puttapasusammattaṃ, byāsattamanasaṃ naraṃ, suttaṃ gāmaṃ mah'ogho'va, maccu ādāya gacchati.

katamāni pañca? rūpabalaṃ, bhogabalaṃ, ñātibalaṃ, puttabalaṃ, sīlabalaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca mātugāmassa balāni. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi balehi samannāgato mātugāmo visārado agāraṃ ajjhāvasatī'ti.

46638.meaning1: because of the power of children

examples.text: na, bhikkhave, mātugāmo rūpabalahetu vā bhogabalahetu vā ñātibalahetu vā puttabalahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati. sīlabalahetu kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.

46639.meaning1: children and wives; wives and kids

examples.text: kiñ'ca, bhikkhave, jātidhammaṃ vadetha? puttabhariyaṃ, bhikkhave, jātidhammaṃ, dāsidāsaṃ jātidhammaṃ, aj'eḷakaṃ jātidhammaṃ, kukkuṭasūkaraṃ jātidhammaṃ
tena hi bhavaṃ govindo satt'āhaṃ āgametu, yāva mayaṃ sake puttabhātaro rajjena anusāsissāma, satt'āhassa accayena mayam'pi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissāma, atha yā te gati, sā no gati bhavissatī'ti.

46642.meaning1: one's son before; previously one's son

46644.meaning1: young enough to be one's son

examples.text: tassa evaṃ hoti, mayaṃ kho pubbe agāriyabhūtā samānā aññe ovadāma'pi anusāsāma'pi. ime pan'amhākaṃ puttamattā maññe nattamattā maññe ovaditabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññantī'ti.

46645.meaning1: death of a son; death of a child

examples.text: dīgharattaṃ vo, bhikkhave, pitumaraṇaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ… bhātumaraṇaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ… bhaginimaraṇaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ… puttamaraṇaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ… dhītumaraṇaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ… ñātibyasanaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ… bhogabyasanaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ.
dve jāyam'patikā taṃ ekaputtakaṃ piyaṃ manāpaṃ vadhitvā vallūrañ'ca soṇḍikañ'ca karitvā puttamaṃsāni khādantā
te puttamaṃsāni c'eva khādeyyuṃ, ure ca paṭipiseyyuṃ, kahaṃ, ekaputtaka, kahaṃ, ekaputtakā'ti

46647.meaning1: similar to a son's flesh; like a child's meat

46648.meaningLit: discourse with the simile of the son's flesh

46649.meaning1: having the appearance of sons; in the guise of children

examples.text: asantā kira maṃ jammā, tāta tātā'ti bhāsare, rakkhasā puttarūpena, te jahanti vayogataṃ.

46650.meaning1: acquisition of a son; obtaining children

examples.text: lābh'ānuttariyañ'ca kathaṃ hoti? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puttalābham'pi labhati, dāralābham'pi labhati, dhanalābham'pi labhati, ucc'āvacaṃ vā pana lābhaṃ labhati, samaṇe vā brāhmaṇe vā micchādiṭṭhike micchāpaṭipanne saddhaṃ paṭilabhati.

46651.meaning1: like (for a) child; like (for one's) children
46651.commentary: (SNa) n'atthi puttasamaṃ peman'ti virūpepi hi attano puttake suvaṇṇabimbakaṃ viya maññanti, mālāguḷe viya sīs'ādīsu katvā pariharamānā tehi ohaditā'pi omuttikā'pi gandhavilepanapatitā viya somanassaṃ āpajjanti.

examples.text: n'atthi puttasamaṃ pemaṃ, n'atthi gosamitaṃ dhanaṃ, n'atthi sūriyasamā ābhā, samuddaparamā sarā'ti.

dujjānaṃ kho etaṃ, mahārāja, tayā gihinā kāmabhoginā puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvasantena kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhontena mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhārayantena jātarūparajataṃ sādiyantena, ime vā arahanto, ime vā arahattamaggaṃ samāpannā'ti.

atirekaṃ kho pan'imassa bhoto satthuno naggiyaṃ muṇḍiyaṃ ukkuṭikappadhānaṃ kesamassulocanaṃ yo'haṃ puttasambādhavasanaṃ ajjhāvasanto kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhonto mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhārento jātarūparajataṃ sādiyanto iminā bhotā satthārā samasamagatiko bhavissāmi abhisamparāyaṃ.

46658.meaning1: grief for a son; sadness over (the loss of) a child

examples.text: puttasoken'ahaṃ aṭṭā, khittacittā visaññinī, naggā pakiṇṇakesī ca, tena tena vicāri'haṃ.

46659.meaning1: gratification in children; pleasure of offspring
46659.commentary: (ANa) tam'eva putt'assādaṃ nikāmayamāno'ti yv'āssa dhītaraṃ vā puttaṃ vā jātaṃ disvā puttapemaṃ putt'assādo uppajjati, taṃ patthayamāno icchamāno.

examples.text: tassa sā hoti brāhmaṇī n'eva kām'atthā na dav'atthā na rat'atthā, paj'atthā'va brāhmaṇassa brāhmaṇī hoti. so methunaṃ uppādetvā tam'eva putt'assādaṃ nikāmayamāno kuṭumbaṃ ajjhāvasati, na agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.
imañ'ca me puttaphalaṃ, kāḷa uppāditaṃ tayā, taṃ maṃ puttavatiṃ santiṃ, kassa ohāya gacchasi.

46661.meaning1: relying on sons; supported by children
46661.commentary: (ANa) sesapadesu pan'ettha ayam'adhippāyo, brāhmaṇā tāva mante labhitvā laddhapatiṭṭhā nāma honti, gahapatikā yaṃkiñci sippaṃ, itthī kuladāyajjasāmikaṃ puttaṃ, corā yaṃkiñci āvudhasatthaṃ, samaṇā sīlaparipuṇṇā laddhapatiṭṭhā nāma honti. tasmā mant'ādhiṭṭhānā'tiādīni vuttāni.

46662.grammar: masc gen pl of putta, irreg form of puttānaṃ

examples.text: khattiyo dvipadaṃ seṭṭho, balībaddo catuppadaṃ, komārī seṭṭhā bhariyānaṃ, yo ca puttāna pubbajo'ti.
socati puttehi puttimā, gomā gohi tath'eva socati, upadhīhi narassa socanā, na hi so socati yo nirūpadhī'ti.

46666.meaning1: (gram) should be separated; should be disconnected (from)

examples.text: pubbabyañjanaṃ sarato puthakkātabbaṃ.

46667.meaning1: master of the earth; leader of the world

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, puthusilā dvedhābhinnā appaṭisandhikā hoti. evam'eva kho, sunakkhatta, ākiñcaññ'āyatan'ādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye āneñjasaṃyojane se bhinne.
ākhyāta-sāgaram'ath'ajjatanī-taraṅ'gaṃ, dhātujjalaṃ vikaraṇ'āgamakālamīnaṃ, lop'ānubandh'ariyam'attha-vibhāga-tīraṃ, dhīrā taranti kavino puthubuddhināvā.
khettaṃ vatthuṃ hiraññaṃ vā, gav'assaṃ dāsaporisaṃ, thiyo bandhū puthu kāme, yo naro anugijjhati.
ye ca saṅkhātadhammāse, ye ca sekhā puthū idha, tesaṃ me nipako iriyaṃ, puṭṭho pabrūhi mārisa.

46671.commentary: (SNa) evaṃ piyo puthu attā paresan'ti yathā ekassa attā piyo, evaṃ paresaṃ puthusattānam'pi attā piyo'ti attho

examples.text: sabbā disā anuparigamma cetasā, n'ev'ajjhagā piyataram'attanā kvaci, evaṃ piyo puthu attā paresaṃ, tasmā na hiṃse param'attakāmo'ti.
tattha katamā cha gehasitā upekkhā? cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā uppajjati upekkhā bālassa mūḷhassa mandassa puthujjanassa anodhijinassa avipākajinassa anādīnavadassāvino assutavato puthujjanassa.

46672.meaning1: in many ways; in different ways

examples.text: att'ūpamā hi te sattā, attā hi paramo piyo, hanti kuddho puthu'ttānaṃ, nānārūpesu mucchito.
ettha rattā pamattā ca, saṅkiliṭṭhamanā narā, aññam'aññena byāruddhā, puthu kubbanti medhagaṃ.

46674.meaning1: armed with various weapons; taking up a variety of weapons
46674.commentary: (SNa) puthu-attadaṇḍā'ti puthu attā daṇḍā etehī'ti puthu-attadaṇḍā, gahita-nānāvidha-daṇḍā'ti attho.

examples.text: kodh'ābhibhūtā puthu-attadaṇḍā, virajjamānā sataṇh'ātaṇhesu, aguttadvārassa bhavanti moghā, supin'eva laddhaṃ purisassa vittaṃ.

46677.meaning1: of diverse form; with different bodies

46678.meaning1: common folk; normal person; worldly person; man in the street

examples.text: sutvā rusito bahuṃ vācaṃ, samaṇānaṃ vā puthujanānaṃ, pharusena ne na paṭivajjā, na hi santo paṭisenikaronti.
yā kāc'imā sammutiyo puthujjā, sabbā'va etā na upeti vidvā, anūpayo so upayaṃ kim'eyya, diṭṭhe sute khantim'akubbamāno.
na brāhmaṇo kappam'upeti saṅkhā, na diṭṭhisārī na'pi ñāṇabandhu, ñatvā ca so sammutiyo puthujjā, upekkhatī uggahaṇanti m'aññe.

46680.meaning1: common man; ordinary man; normal person; man in the street
46680.commentary: (MNa) so hi puthūnaṃ nānappakārānaṃ kilesādīnaṃ jananādīhi kāraṇehi puthujjano. yath'āha, puthu kilese janentī'ti puthujjanā, puthu avihatasakkāyadiṭṭhikā'ti puthujjanā, puthu satthārānaṃ mukham'ullokikā'ti puthujjanā, puthu sabbagatīhi avuṭṭhitā'ti puthujjanā, puthu nān'ābhisaṅkhāre abhisaṅkharontī'ti puthujjanā, puthu nānāoghehi vuyhantī'ti puthujjanā, puthu nānāsantāpehi santappantī'ti puthujjanā, puthu nānāpariḷāhehi paridayhantī'ti puthujjanā, puthu pañcasu kāmaguṇesu rattā giddhā gadhitā mucchitā ajjhosannā laggā lagitā palibuddhā'ti puthujjanā, puthu pañcahi nīvaraṇehi āvuṭā nivutā ovutā pihitā paṭicchannā paṭikujjitāti puthujjanā'ti (mahāni. 51). puthūnaṃ vā gaṇanapatham'atītānaṃ ariyadhammaparammukhānaṃ nīcadhammasamācārānaṃ janānaṃ antogadhattā'pi puthujjanā. puthu vā ayaṃ, visuṃ'y'eva saṅkhaṃ gato, visaṃsaṭṭho sīlasut'ādiguṇayuttehi ariyehi jano'ti'pi puthujjano.

examples.text: diṭṭhi-saṃyojana-saṃyutto, bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano na parimuccati jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, na parimuccati dukkhasmā'ti vadāmi
hitvā icchañ'ca lobhañ'ca, yattha satto puthujjano, cakkhumā paṭipajjeyya, tareyya narakaṃ imaṃ.

46682.meaning1: become common; become wide-spread; become popular

examples.text: sā eta'r'ahi anupubbena puthujjanagatā.

46683.meaning1: common idiom; wide-spread expression; worldly saying

examples.text: sā eta'r'ahi anupubbena puthujjanagāthā.

46684.meaning1: ordinary unethical person; common immoral man
46684.commentary: (MNa) puthujjanadussīle'ti puthujjanadussīlā nāma kevaṭṭamacchabandh'ādayo paraṃ pīḷāya jīvikaṃ kappetā.

examples.text: puthujjanasīlavante dānaṃ deti, ayaṃ dvādasamī pāṭipuggalikā dakkhiṇā. puthujjanadussīle dānaṃ deti, ayaṃ terasamī pāṭipuggalikā dakkhiṇā. tiracchānagate dānaṃ deti, ayaṃ cuddasamī pāṭipuggalikā dakkhiṇā'ti.

46685.meaning1: category of common people; set of ordinary men

examples.text: yassa kho, bhikkhave, imāni pañc'indriyāni sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ n'atthi, tam'ahaṃ bāhiro puthujjanapakkhe ṭhito'ti vadāmī'ti.

46686.meaning1: highest state of being for a common person; peak of existence for a normal man

46687.meaning1: ending in the highest state of being for a common person

46688.meaning1: level of the common man; stage of being a normal person

examples.text: yo, bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṃ saddahati adhimuccati, ayaṃ vuccati saddh'ānusārī, okkanto sammattaniyāmaṃ, sappurisabhūmiṃ okkanto, vītivatto puthujjanabhūmiṃ.

46689.meaning1: ordinary ethical person; common moral man
46689.commentary: (MNa) puthujjanasīlavante'ti puthujjanasīlavā nāma gosīladhātuko hoti, asaṭho amāyāvī paraṃ apīḷetvā dhammena samena kasiyā vā vaṇijjāya vā jīvikaṃ kappetā.

examples.text: bāhirake kāmesu vītarāge dānaṃ deti, ayaṃ ekādasamī pāṭipuggalikā dakkhiṇā. puthujjanasīlavante dānaṃ deti, ayaṃ dvādasamī pāṭipuggalikā dakkhiṇā. puthujjanadussīle dānaṃ deti, ayaṃ terasamī pāṭipuggalikā dakkhiṇā.

46690.meaning1: common comfort; plebeian pleasure; worldly happiness

examples.text: yaṃ kho, udāyi, ime pañca kāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ idaṃ vuccati kāmasukhaṃ miḷhasukhaṃ puthujjanasukhaṃ anariyasukhaṃ, na sevitabbaṃ, na bhāvetabbaṃ, na bahulīkātabbaṃ, bhāyitabbaṃ etassa sukhassā'ti vadāmi.

46691.meaning1: regarding the common man; about a normal person

examples.text: puthujjanavasena paṭhamanayabhūmiparicchedo niṭṭhito.

samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo saṅghī gaṇī gaṇ'ācariyo puthutitthakarānaṃ aggam'akkhāyati. yathā kho pana, bho, etesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ yathā vā tathā vā yaso samudāgacchati, na h'evaṃ samaṇassa gotamassa yaso samudāgato.
tassa imissā ca asappāyakiriyāya, asuci visadoso apanīto saupādiseso tadubhayena vaṇo puthuttaṃ gaccheyya.
tassa imissā ca asappāyakiriyāya, asuci visadoso apanīto saupādiseso tadubhayena vaṇo puthuttaṃ gaccheyya.

46695.commentary: (DNa) puthudisā'ti bahudisā. (DNt) puthudisā'ti visuṃ visuṃ disā, tā pana anekā'ti āha bahudisā'ti.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena siṅgālako gahapatiputto kālass'eva uṭṭhāya rājagahā nikkhamitvā allavattho allakeso pañjaliko puthudisā namassati, puratthimaṃ disaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ pacchimaṃ disaṃ uttaraṃ disaṃ heṭṭhimaṃ disaṃ uparimaṃ disaṃ.

tena kho pana samayena siṅgālako gahapatiputto kālass'eva uṭṭhāya rājagahā nikkhamitvā allavattho allakeso pañjaliko puthuddisā namassati, puratthimaṃ disaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ pacchimaṃ disaṃ uttaraṃ disaṃ heṭṭhimaṃ disaṃ uparimaṃ disaṃ.
idaṃ vatvāna maghavā, devarājā sujampati, puthuddisā namassitvā, pamukho ratham'āruhī'ti.

46697.commentary: (DNa) puthupaccekasaccānī'ti bahūni pāṭekkasaccāni, idam'eva dassanaṃ saccaṃ, idam'eva dassanaṃ saccan'ti evaṃ pāṭiyekkaṃ gahitāni bahūni saccānī'ti attho.

examples.text: kathañ'c'āvuso, bhikkhu paṇunnapaccekasacco hoti? idh'āvuso, bhikkhuno yāni tāni puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ puthupaccekasaccāni, sabbāni tāni nunnāni honti paṇunnāni cattāni vantāni muttāni pahīnāni paṭinissaṭṭhāni. evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu paṇunnapaccekasacco hoti.

46698.meaning1: of broad understanding; having wide-ranging wisdom

examples.text: paṇḍito, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto. mahāpañño, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto. puthupañño, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto. hāsapañño, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto. javanapañño, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto. tikkhapañño, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto.

46699.meaning1: state of broad understanding; fact of having wide-ranging wisdom
46699.commentary: (PM) puthupaññatāya saṃvattantī'ti katamā puthupaññā? puthunānākhandhesu ñāṇaṃ pavattatī'ti, puthupaññā. puthunānādhātūsu ñāṇaṃ pavattatī'ti, puthupaññā. puthunānāāyatanesu ñāṇaṃ pavattatī'ti, puthupaññā. puthunānāpaṭiccasamuppādesu ñāṇaṃ pavattatī'ti, puthupaññā.

examples.text: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā puthupaññatā saṃvattantī'ti.
